Headline: 1,50,000 and 23,000 Unit Promoter Shares of SHINE and GBLBS in Auction From Today
Full Content:
Prudential Capital Management Company Private Limited is auctioning 1,50,000 units and 23,000 unit promoter shares of
Shine Resunga Development Bank Limited (SHINE)
and
Grameen Bikas Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited (GBLBS)
respectively. The auction is open from today i.e 20th Shrawan and will close on 26th Shrawan, 2079.
Existing promoters, individual investors, companies, and institutions are all eligible to bid for an auction. While the minimum bid quantity for SHINE is 5000 units and for GBLBS is 2000 units, there is no upper limit. However, bidders are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
Rs. 150 is the minimum bid rate for the auction of promoter shares of SHINE whereas minimum bid rate for GBLBS 's auction is Rs. 350. NIC Asia Capital is appointed as the auction manager for both the auction.

Headline: Promoter Shares of These Companies Will Be Auctioned
Full Content:
Sarathi Nepal Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited is auctioning its 4,158.50 units promoter shares. The auction will open on 17th Baisakh and close on 24th Baisakh, 2078.
Only existing promoters are eligible to bid for the auction. Rs. 100 is the minimum bid rate while the minimum bid quantity is 100 units.

Headline: Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund (DCGF) auctioning promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta and Grameen Bikas Laghubitta
Full Content:
Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund (DCGF) is auctioning the promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta and Grameen Bikas Laghubitta.
DCGF is a government-sponsored and administered separate entity. As a deposit insurer, Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund started the deposit guarantee scheme in Nepal from the year 2010. It is a system that protects depositors against the loss of their guaranteed deposits placed with banks and financial institutions (BFIs) in case of events leading to BFIs failure.
Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund is auctioning 2,632 units promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited and 3,194 units promoter shares of Grameen Bikas Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited.
The auction is open for existing promoters, the general public, and institutions from today, i.e. 17th Kartik. Both the auctions will conclude on 1st Mangsir, 2077.
The minimum bid quantity is 500 units. While bidders can bid for the entirety of shares in each auction, any quantity in between should be a multiple of 500. The minimum bid rate is Rs. 398.75 for the promoter shares of RMDC Laghubitta. Meanwhile, the minimum bid rate is Rs. 109.70 for the promoter shares of Grameen Bikas Laghubitta.
Bidders will have to deposit 10% of the monetary bid amount as collateral while bidding for each of the auction. For more info, refers to the auction notice below.
